title: Longest Subarray of 1s After Deleting One Element
description: Find the longest subarray of 1s after deleting exactly one element from a binary array.
pseudocode:
1. left = 0, zeros = 0, maxLen = 0
2. for right from 0 to n-1:
3.   if nums[right] == 0: zeros++
4.   while zeros > 1:
5.     if nums[left] == 0: zeros--
6.     left++
7.   maxLen = max(maxLen, right - left)

steps.note: Initialize window pointers and zero counter.
Found zero at index 2, increment zero count.
